Invalidation of Code

Should this code or any provision of this code be held invalid as a codification, then those ordinances from which the invalidated provision derives or upon which it is based shall remain in full force and effect as if this code had not been adopted.

Date Passed: Monday, January 22, 2007

Effective Date: Sunday, March 4, 2007

Recodification ORD C33969 Section 1
